name: Altilly
rootCause: The Altilly Exchange platform was attacked by legally authorized access. According to the official weighing, the attacker gained access to 30 BTC and 12,000 USDT and stole them while controlling the server.

descriptions.text: The Altilly Exchange platform was attacked by legally authorized access. According to the official weighing, the attacker gained access to 30 BTC and 12,000 USDT and stole them while controlling the server.

On December 26, 2020, Altilly, a centralized exchange, suffered a severe server and hot wallet compromise after attackers gained admin-level access to the hosting provider account lacking two-factor authentication. Backup deletion and wallet loss resulted in an unrecoverable loss of at least $750,000 and the platform's immediate shutdown. The attacker exploited a hosting provider administrator account without two-factor authentication to gain full control over Altilly's infrastructure.
